euMembership.sourceText: 27 EU Member States: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden.

gccMembership.resolutionNote: Carried over UNCHANGED from the pre-existing tax/classification.ts GCC_VAT set (all 6 Unified VAT Agreement signatories: SA, AE, BH, OM, KW, QA), itself never cited to a primary source in this codebase's history. What would settle this: confirm against each GCC member's own VAT law whether it has actually brought the Unified VAT Agreement into force (Saudi Arabia and the UAE since 2018, Bahrain since 2019, Oman since 2021), rather than carrying every signatory forward as if implemented - Qatar and Kuwait in particular had not enacted a domestic VAT law as of the last time this set was written. Not re-researched by this PR, which only moves the existing fact into one shared table - see this PR's own report.

ocrRecognition.resolutionNote: Not a legal fact - a product decision about which 2-letter prefixes the OCR upload-screen heuristic should treat as VAT-id-shaped, carried over UNCHANGED from ocr-service/local-client.ts's own prior EU_VAT_PREFIXES comment (every EU member, plus Greece's dual GR/EL prefixes, plus CH/NO/GB/XI). Revisit only if the OCR heuristic's own target audience changes.

countries.notes: Not an EU/GCC member. Northern Ireland's own post-Brexit VAT prefix under the Windsor Framework. Not an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code at all (ISO assigns no code to Northern Ireland separately from 'GB') - carried over from ocr-service/local-client.ts's own prior EU_VAT_PREFIXES comment, which already listed 'XI' for exactly this reason.
